researchQuestion: Do pre-T−48 conjunction histories contain enough predictive signal to improve forecasts of later reported log10(Pc) over persistence?

definitions.mae: Mean absolute error in log10(Pc) units on the final reported risk.
definitions.esaLoss: ESA-style loss is high-risk MSE divided by F2 (F-beta with β=2), so recall of the log10(Pc) ≥ −6 class is weighted more than precision.
definitions.falseReassurance: An accepted forecast (no abstention) with predicted log10(Pc) < −6 while the final reported value is ≥ −6.
definitions.floorExcludedMae: MAE on events whose final reported log10(Pc) is above the dataset floor of -30.
definitions.residualMaeActual: Mean |y - risk|: how far the later report moved from the T-48 snapshot.
definitions.residualMaePredicted: Mean |pred - risk|: how far the model moves the snapshot.
definitions.residualMae: Mean |(y - risk) - (pred - risk)|, equal to MAE(y, pred).
definitions.maeAdvantageCi: 95% bootstrap interval on MAE(persistence) - MAE(model) from 1000 event resamples.
definitions.selectedPolicy: Validation winner on MAE, then floor-excluded MAE, then ESA-style loss. Test and official-test are reports only.

dilutionProbe.hypothesis: Events whose pessimistic max-risk sits far above the current report, or whose covariance is still large, move more before TCA. F10 is a negative control. This is not a covariance-tasking model.

featureCatalog.note: All features use only cutoff-safe CDM rows. dilution_gap is a research probe and is excluded from the shipped regressor.

censoring.framing: −30 is a reporting floor / censored target, not a precise physical Pc. A two-part hurdle models floor vs non-floor; Tobit-style censored regression is an alternative not fit here.

matchedCohortHorizons.note: Same events observed at 72/48/24/12 h. Train/test IDs are the seed-42 split intersected with that cohort, so horizon comparisons are not mixed with a changing eligible set.

missionGrouped.note: The public archive has no NORAD or object-pair identifiers and no calendar dates. Mission grouping is the available entity split. Official-test scoring is the frozen distribution-shift check.
missionGrouped.refit: Unguarded XGBoost only, same trees/depth/lr as the shipped regressor. The live floor-hurdle threshold 0.15 is not retuned on this split.

falsePositives.note: False floor calls are later reports that did not sit at −30. Many sit near the floor rather than in the high-risk tail.

scientificBaselines.note: Trend is clipped one-step extrapolation from the last two cutoff-safe risk reports. Family models are extra measurements, not shipped policies.

simpleFloorBaselines.note: Simple floor detectors trained on the frozen train split only. If logistic on two fields approaches the XGBoost floor classifier, the finding is the data structure, not the booster.

conformalDepth.interpretation: Split conformal is statistically honest on average but operationally wide: most of the 90% width is paid on heterogeneous non-floor events.

selectivePrediction.rule: Abstain when the split-conformal band around the frozen floor-hurdle point crosses log10(Pc) ≥ −6, or when risk or miss distance is missing.
